symptom: Delay when using Keurig K-cup Pod dispenser

symptom: After brewing, my powdered beverage is not fully cleared from the used pod

symptom: Brewer lid is difficult to close
what_to_do: Press K-cup all the way down into the brewer prior to closing the lid. Lower needle must puncture K-cup bfore closing the brewer lid

symptom: Brewer leaks during the brew cycle

what_to_do: Press K-cup all the way down into the brewer prior to closing the lid. Lower needle must puncture K-cup before closing the brewer lid. Recommend using official Keurig K-cups that have not been damaged and have a good seal between the top cover and plastic bottom
